objection.status: error reported by an ordinary grader
objection.quote: Repeating the operation on the uncancelled array whose parity is odd proves by induction on $s$ that its odd levels have total length at most $d$.
objection.witness: The construction for part (i) never rigorously defines the two arrays or proves that the proposed operation corresponds to legal splits and leaves a subproblem satisfying the induction hypotheses. The claimed bound on the final alternating imbalance therefore does not follow.
